title: The Shortest War in History
hook: A standard television episode lasts longer than an entire international war.
script: A standard television episode lasts longer than an entire international war. How did Britain and Zanzibar settle a war in thirty-eight minutes? In 1896, British warships sank an armed yacht Queen Victoria had personally gifted. The shelling only continued because nobody could reach the palace roof to surrender. A shell finally snapped the flagpole. Arranging the ceasefire took longer than the actual combat. Britain even billed the shattered palace for the artillery fired at them. An entire kingdom fell in less time than a lunch break.

captions: Could any conflict today be over in 38 minutes, or is modern warfare permanently prolonged? This was the shortest war in recorded history.
The 1896 Anglo-Zanzibar conflict remains history's fastest military collapse.
A entire fleet sunk and a surrender signed in less time than a sitcom.
